## About
Al Haya Cleaning Services is a UAE-based professional cleaning company specializing in
villa cleaning, apartment cleaning, and deep cleaning. We serve residential and commercial
clients across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain, Ras Al Khaimah, and Fujairah.
Our trained, vetted teams use eco-friendly, family- and pet-safe products and bring all
equipment and supplies to every job.

## Services Offered
- Villa Cleaning — full cleaning for luxury and family villas
- Apartment Cleaning — studios, 1/2/3 BHK, and penthouses
- Deep Cleaning — intensive top-to-bottom cleaning for homes and villas
- Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning — to landlord-inspection standards for deposit refunds
- Office Cleaning — commercial cleaning with flexible scheduling
- Sofa & Carpet Cleaning — deep shampoo + steam cleaning for upholstery, carpets, rugs
- Window Cleaning — interior and exterior, streak-free, all building heights
- Post-Construction Cleaning — heavy-duty cleanup after renovations and fit-outs
- Curtains & Blinds Cleaning — on-site steam cleaning, no removal needed
- Mattress Deep Cleaning — shampoo + sanitization, removes dust mites and stains
- Car Seats & Interior Cleaning — mobile doorstep detailing across the UAE

## Coverage Areas
Dubai: Jumeirah, Al Barsha, Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, Business Bay, Palm Jumeirah, JBR, Silicon Oasis
Abu Dhabi: Al Reem Island, Saadiyat Island, Khalifa City, Corniche, Al Ain
Sharjah: Al Nahda, Al Majaz, Al Khan, Muwaileh
Ajman: Al Rashidiya, Al Nuaimia, Emirates City
Umm Al Quwain: UAQ Marina, Old Town, Al Salamah
Ras Al Khaimah: Al Hamra, Al Marjan Island, RAK City, Khuzam
Fujairah: Fujairah City, Dibba Al Fujairah, Kalba

## Business Hours
Monday to Sunday: 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM
Same-day and urgent cleaning available on request.

## Key Features
- Trained, background-checked, and vetted cleaning staff
- Eco-friendly, non-toxic products safe for children and pets
- All equipment and supplies provided
- One-time, weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly schedules
- Move-in/move-out and turnover cleaning for rentals and holiday homes
- Transparent pricing with free, no-obligation quotes
- Serving residential and commercial properties across all 7 UAE Emirates
